highResTransform.description: Cloudflare imagedelivery.net serves images with a width parameter; swap w=1024 for w=2048 to get double resolution

notes: Custom Next.js storefront (not Shopify/WooCommerce/Magento). Color swatches are <a> tags with role='option' inside a role='listbox' (.variant-picker__variant-list). Clicking a color navigates to a fully separate URL (e.g. /product/norah-comfort-underwire-bra-black) — full page reload, NOT in-place swap. No lightbox: clicking product images triggers an inline xy-zoom (class 'zoomed' added to .pdp-product-images__image, class 'zoomed-img' added to the img). No thumbnail strip — all images render in a 2-column vertical scroll grid. Lazy loading uses native loading='lazy' plus a .pdp-product-images__image--blurring class on not-yet-loaded frames. Some products have two color groups (Core + Sale), each with its own .variant-picker__variant-list. No bot protection detected.
